name: pen_placement
description: Polygon pen click plane (cells A0, E, B0, B1, B2): point 0 lands on the principal plane through the camera focus; every later click lands on the plane PARALLEL to it through the CURRENT point and is inserted right after it (append = the current point is the last); a dragged point moves on the plane through its OWN position. Positions are world (the automatic work plane is the identity frame). Only the Y of each new or dragged point is the law under test; x/z are the clicked positions.

provenance.notes: GUI worker per cell (fresh boot), new empty foreground mesh, no background geometry, top orthographic view, camera focus height 1.0; real pointer clicks/drag in the viewport; point heights set by typing into the tool panel's Current Point / Position Y fields between clicks (no script call while the stroke was live); one mesh dump after the last gesture. Rings and facing are not scored here.

law: A click while drawing lands on the plane parallel to the placement plane through the CURRENT point, and the new point is inserted right after the current point (append = current is the last point). A dragged point moves on the plane through its OWN position.

script: press on p1 and drag +40 px in screen x
B2_drag.not_scored: the dragged point's x/z depend on the pointer transport and the zoom; only its y is the law

quantum.description: Placement quantum (cells B4a, B4b, B4c, KC_110, KC_622): every clicked point's two in-plane channels are rounded to the view's grid sub-step q = one pixel of world rounded UP on the 1/2/5 ladder; the plane-normal channel is not rounded. Supersedes rig.grid_quantum 0.01 (the earlier cells lie on 0.01 multiples by their pixels, not by the law).

provenance.notes: GUI worker per cell (fresh boot), new empty foreground mesh, top orthographic view unless stated, focus plane y 1.0, real pointer clicks; mesh readback. px_per_m is the reference view's pixels per metre; q_lower is the ladder rung below q, so (q_lower, q] is the bracket a pixel size must sit in for q to be its sub-step.

B4c.not_scored: perspective: the reference's pixel size is 0.8 of a real pixel at the focus, so a fixture value is not reachable exactly; scored as lattice membership under the view's own sub-step
